description: RADIAÇÃO ELETROMAGNÉTICA ANTENA - 2021 BELO HORIZONTE is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Realizado com periodicidade anual, o monitoramento radiométrico dos campos eletromagnéticos de estações transmissoras de telecomunicações, também conhecido como radiação eletromagnética, traz as medições realizadas em diversos pontos do município de Belo Horizonte, no ano de 2021, com o uso de aparelhos destinados exclusivamente para este fim. Coverage: Belo Horizonte. Its tags are Radiação, Antenas, Monitoramento, Ambiente, location. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
